# 1 Enoch Chapter 72 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Astronomical Book (Book of Luminaries)

---

**72:1** The book of the courses of the luminaries of heaven, each in relation to its class, its dominion and its season, according to their names and places of origin, and according to their months — which Uriel, the holy angel who was with me and who is their guide, showed to me. He showed me all their laws, exactly as they are, concerning all the years of the world and unto eternity, until the new creation is accomplished that endures forever.

**72:2** This is the first law of the luminaries: the sun has its rising in the eastern gates of heaven and its setting in the western gates of heaven.

**72:3** I saw six gates in which the sun rises and six gates in which the sun sets. The moon also rises and sets through these gates, as do the leaders of the stars and those they lead — six in the east and six in the west — all following one another in precisely corresponding order. And there were many windows to the right and left of these gates.
